  • VERSATILE STORAGE OPTIONS: Three open compartments, two doors and two drawers provide ample storage space.
  • PUSH-TO-OPEN SYSTEM: Drawers open with light pressure, no visible handles necessary.
  • LED LIGHTING: Controllable via smartphone app via Bluetooth, a wide range of colour and brightness settings.

Descriptions

The 160*35*60cm high-gloss TV cabinet combines modern design with functional features and is the ideal addition to your living room. The cabinet offers a generous platform for TVs up to 70 inches and provides an elegant look thanks to its smooth, glossy surface. The front of the cabinet impresses with its high-gloss look, which is not only aesthetically pleasing, but also easy to clean and maintain. This TV cabinet has three open compartments that are ideal for placing multimedia devices such as DVD players, game consoles or receivers. Each of these compartments is equipped with its own cable management hole, which allows for neat and unobtrusive cable management. This keeps your entertainment area tidy and clear at all times. The open design also makes it easier to access your devices and ensures good ventilation, which prevents overheating. In addition to the open compartments, the cabinet offers two doors and two drawers that provide further storage space for DVDs, games or other personal items. The doors are equipped with high-quality, low-noise hinges that allow for smooth and quiet opening and closing. The two drawers open by pressing lightly thanks to the push-to-open mechanism, which made it possible to dispense with visible handles and give the cabinet a clean, minimalist design.

A special highlight of this TV cabinet is the integrated LED lighting, which can be controlled via a smartphone app via Bluetooth. This innovative lighting feature allows you to adjust the color, brightness, and color temperature of the LEDs according to your preferences. Whether it's warm, cosy lighting for a movie night or cool, bright lighting for a lively evening with friends – the possibilities are endless. In addition, the app offers a timer function that allows you to automatically turn the lights on and off, which is not only practical, but also helps to save energy. Particularly impressive is the music control function of the LED lighting, which allows the light to pulse to the rhythm of the music being played. This feature creates a dynamic atmosphere that is perfect for parties or relaxing evenings. The TV cabinet transforms your living room into an atmospheric entertainment centre. The cabinet is made of sturdy materials that guarantee a long service life. The sturdy construction ensures that the cabinet remains stable even when fully loaded, ensuring safe storage of your devices and items. The high-quality workmanship and the use of durable materials make this TV cabinet a worthwhile investment for your home.

Thanks to the detailed assembly instructions, the cabinet can be set up easily and quickly. The clear step-by-step instructions ensure that even inexperienced do-it-yourselfers can master the assembly without any problems. In addition, the cabinet offers a well thought-out cable management system that helps to organize all cables neatly and lay them invisibly. The 160*35*60cm High Gloss TV Cabinet is not only a functional storage place for your consumer electronics, but also a stylish piece of furniture that will enhance your living room.
